sentences.show: A baseball team waited 108 years for a title, and blamed a goat.
On this night in 2016, the Chicago Cubs finally won the World Series.
Their last title had come in 1908.
Then, in 1945, a tavern owner brought his pet goat, Murphy, to a World Series game at Wrigley Field.
The goat was bothering fans. They were asked to leave.
He's said to have declared: "Them Cubs, they ain't gonna win no more."
The Cubs didn't reach another World Series for 71 years.
In 2016 they did, against Cleveland, and fell behind three games to one.
They fought back, to a Game 7. It went to extra innings.
Then, of all things, it rained.
After the delay, Ben Zobrist hit the go-ahead double. The Cubs won, 8 to 7.
More than 40 million people watched the longest drought in American sports come to an end.
Also on this day: Britain opened its first motorway, and the first crew moved into the International Space Station.
The Cubs waited a hundred and eight years. Our app won't take that long. Subscribe, and be in the stands.
